text:
alex: hey all, quick intro — alex here, first day! got my laptop but running into a weird combo: Okta dashboard shows apps, but clicking any app returns 'Access denied (MFA required)'. Google Drive doesn't show the team folder even though my manager shared it. 1Password invite link opens but then errors with 'account mismatch'. also tried registering a YubiKey and Chrome reports 'USB device blocked by extension'. who should I ping?
it-support: welcome alex! can you confirm the email you used to sign in? also which Chrome extensions are installed (enterprise ones like 'USB guard' can block keys)?
alex: signed in with alex.jones@redwood.com. extensions look standard but I do see 'Endpoint Protector' pushed by IT. manager shared folder link but it still asks for access. 1Password invite email shows my name but the top of the invite says 'linked to alex.jones+personal@gmail.com' — something odd.
onboarding-bot: Welcome! Typical provisioning workflow: Okta -> SCIM -> apps/Drive/1Password. If any step fails, tag @it-support and @idp-team. Docs: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/troubleshoot :book:
idp-team: tagging in. I see two accounts in Okta: alex.jones@redwood.com and alex.jones+personal@gmail.com mapped due to an alias import from Google sync. That would explain the 1Password token mismatch and why Drive ACLs didn't apply correctly. I'll merge the duplicate identities and force a resync.
samir: re: MFA policy 02: 'require strong MFA for app access' is firing because your primary device isn't enrolled. We can exempt temporarily while you register a hardware key or Okta Verify.
it-support: for the Chrome extension blocking USB, that 'Endpoint Protector' enforces USB filtering. We can push a policy to allow WebAuthn devices for new hires, or you can register the key using Safari/Edge. As a workaround, we can enable Okta Verify on your phone to satisfy the MFA requirement immediately.
alex: thanks. can you merge the accounts? i prefer not to touch personal email in the company account.
idp-team: merged aliases, removed the +personal account mapping, and re-ran SCIM at 14:12 UTC. apps show assigned now. we also invalidated old 1Password invite and created a new invite tied to your corporate account; check your corporate inbox.
it-support: pushed a temporary USB allow policy for your machine and reissued the YubiKey registration flow. try now in Chrome after a browser restart.
alex: re-sent 1Password link worked! Drive still showed 'request access' but after refresh I can open the team folder. YubiKey registration still fails with the same Chrome error until I restart Chrome; after restart it completes successfully. okta app access now opens too.
samir: summary: root cause was duplicate identity/alias from Google sync causing token/account mismatches for 1Password and ACLs; MF A policy blocked app access until an enrolled factor was present. Endpoint Protector initially blocked WebAuthn until IT allowed device class for new hires. Remediations: idp-team merged alias and hardened SCIM filters, security team to add a rule to prevent importing +alias addresses, it-support added temporary USB allow policy and will add a one-click onboarding helper to avoid manual extension changes.
alex: massive thanks everyone 2b50 excited to get started. who should I DM about team onboarding docs?
it-support: ping @samir for team tour and @onboarding-bot will post the squad doc links. closing loop: alias merged, 1Password & Drive fixed, YubiKey registered, temporary USB policy applied. :white_check_mark:
